name: streamient-memory-20261009
description: Streamient gives ChatGPT access to a user's authenticated private memory workspace. Users can search and retrieve notes, memories, and project metadata, then create new private notes and memories when requested.

interface.longDescription: Streamient gives ChatGPT access to a user's authenticated private memory workspace. Users can search and retrieve notes, memories, and project metadata, then create new private notes and memories when requested.

positive.description: Search and read notes in the review demo workspace.
positive.prompt: Search my Streamient notes for OpenAI review demo and open the product launch note.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds and reads the matching note, then summarizes its launch checklist and related context.

positive.prompt: What reviewer preference memories do I have for the OpenAI app submission?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching memory records such as reviewer preferences and summarizes the relevant guidance.

positive.description: Create persistent memory from a user instruction.
positive.prompt: Remember that OpenAI app review answers should be concise and source-backed.
positive.expected_behavior: Stores a new memory in the user's workspace and confirms what was remembered.

positive.description: Create a project note from conversation context.
positive.prompt: Create a note titled OpenAI review follow-up with a short checklist for testing OAuth and memory search.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a private note with the requested title and checklist content.

positive.prompt: List my Streamient projects and show the note and memory counts.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists available projects and returns private workspace counts without changing data.

negative.description: Do not invoke Streamient to save or crawl external URLs.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because URL saving, fetching, and crawling are not exposed in the public ChatGPT app profile.

negative.description: Do not invoke Streamient to search or read email.
negative.prompt: Find the demo review checklist email and summarize it.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because email tools are not exposed in the public ChatGPT app profile.

negative.description: Do not invoke Streamient to sync git repositories.
negative.prompt: Add https://github.com/streamient/streamient as a git sync repository.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because git sync tools are not exposed in the public ChatGPT app profile.

publication.release_notes: Initial fresh Streamient submission package. Includes the existing Streamient Memory skill and listing metadata, square listing icons, and the public notes, memories, and project MCP endpoint.
